description: This file declares the Stop class, which is a task for stopping web audio playback in a media server component. It includes class declaration, constructor, destructor, and execute method, and references external interfaces for web audio player and task management.

classes.name: Stop
classes.description: A task class responsible for stopping web audio playback, implementing the IPlayerTask interface.

methods.description: Constructor that initializes the Stop task with a reference to the web audio player.
